info.name: Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions CRD Status API

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the CRD in the format {plural}.{group} (e.g. databases.example.com).

items.docs: Returns the status subresource of the specified CustomResourceDefinition, including the Established, NamesAccepted, and Terminating conditions and the list of stored versions.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the CRD in the format {plural}.{group} (e.g. databases.example.com).

items.docs: Replaces the status subresource of the specified CRD. Used by the apiextensions controller to report whether the CRD has been established and names have been accepted.
